verdict.rationale: Mercury's API exposes transactions, categories, merchants, invoices, and statement PDFs, and explicitly supports AI-agent access via llms.txt/OpenAPI (mercury-docs-12,13,14), enabling significant data extraction in open formats. However, there's no explicit 'export all account data and close' feature or full data portability guarantee, and the OpenAPI spec itself wasn't found at expected endpoints (mercury-probe-2).
